meta.importNote: The CMS import consumes the folders array. The top-level meta and scalingRules keys are tooling metadata. Each folder carries extra code and slug fields - stable identifiers used by the idea catalog and page generators. Never rename or reuse a code.

scalingRules: CMS folders are created ONLY by importing this file. Never create, rename or delete folders manually in the CMS UI - change this file first, then re-import.
Split rule - when a subcategory passes 60 tools, split it into new subcategories under the same category. New subcategory codes are appended (next letter). Existing codes are never renamed or reused.
Utilities enforcement - the Utilities / Misc Helpers leaves (B-G-14, P-G-06) are parking spots only. Whenever a real category exists for a tool, it moves there. Utilities must stay near-empty.
New category or subcategory is a deliberate decision made in this file first (new code), followed by re-importing the file.

Boundary rules - PERSONAL only when the user manages their own life (default is BUSINESS). VERTICAL only when industry-specific content or workflow is baked in, otherwise GENERAL. HR is GENERAL because every company has HR.
One tool = one folder = one subcategory in this file. A tool that serves several audiences can be multi-listed in the store app, but has one home here.
Tags and search facets are managed inside the HtmlToolLibraryItem application, not in this hierarchy. This hierarchy is only the filing system for tools entering the CMS.
